detector.name: EIP712-Encoding-and-Replay-Protection
detector.vulnerability_knowledge: EIP-712 requires structured data to be hashed in a specific nested manner: the typehash is hashed together with the keccak256 of the encoded parameters, not with the raw parameters themselves. Dynamic types (bytes, string, arrays) must be keccak256-hashed before being included in the outer abi.encode. Using abi.encodePacked on arrays or omitting the inner keccak256 violates the standard and produces a different digest than off-chain signers (e.g., MetaMask, ethers.js) compute, causing valid signatures to fail or enabling cross-function replay if the same digest is accepted for multiple actions. Additionally, every signed payload must include a strictly incrementing nonce (or equivalent replay protection) bound to the signer and the contract domain; missing or predictable nonces allow an attacker to replay a captured signature to execute the same operation repeatedly.
checks: Verify that the digest computation uses keccak256(abi.encode(typehash, keccak256(abi.encode(...parameters...)))) for struct types and keccak256(abi.encodePacked(...)) only for static primitives; dynamic arrays/bytes/strings must be hashed before the outer encode.
Confirm that array parameters are not passed through abi.encodePacked directly into the outer abi.encode; each dynamic array must be keccak256(abi.encode(array)) first.
Ensure the domain separator (name, version, chainId, verifyingContract) is incorporated exactly as specified in EIP-712 and matches the off-chain signing domain.
Check that a nonce is retrieved and atomically incremented per signer (or per relevant scope) before digest calculation, and that the nonce is included in the signed payload.
Validate that the deadline/expiration timestamp is included in the signed data and enforced during verification to prevent indefinite replay.
Confirm that the recovered address from ecrecover matches the expected signer and that the signature format (r, s, v or compact) is handled correctly.
Ensure no two distinct functions or actions share the same typehash or digest structure, which would allow cross-function signature replay.
Verify that the contract does not accept signatures signed by an EOA for a different chainId or verifyingContract (domain separation).

incorrect_example.explanation: The typehash and parameters are hashed together in a single keccak256(abi.encode(...)), violating EIP-712 structured hashing which requires the typehash to be paired with the keccak256 of the encoded parameters.

correct_example.explanation: Parameters are encoded and hashed separately, then combined with the typehash inside a structHash; nonce is incremented and deadline enforced before digest calculation.
